name.title: DP_AVS_EMEM_BLOCK_REMAP_TABLE
name.sysdesc: DP of the contents of the EMEM block remap table. This table is the physical block to logical block mapping (the stripes).

field.sysdesc: EMEM board id register value when this data product is generated.
Unique FSW build id number from the FSW build that this data product was generated.

array.sysdesc: Each entry in this table represent a single entry in the block remap table. Data in the block remap table is CRC'ed in block_remap_table_crc_size chunks. There will always be an integer number of remap_table_chunk entries (The number of blocks in each lane is evenly divisible by block_remap_table_crc_size)

field.sysdesc: The CRC value for the preceding remap table data
